Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a 3rd horde shooter set in the Aliens universe where you get to be badass marines and shoot Xenomorphs, what isn't there to love?

You can play Solo with bots or multiplayer with friends, I have had fun with the bots decimating Xenomorphs because none of my friends have this game to play with me. The story is pretty lackluster, can't really hear it over all the Xenomorph heads you will be popping but the game is LEAGUES better than Aliens Colonial Marines.

What are you waiting for? Pull the trigger and go on another bug hunt.

Gotta start by saying this game has great gun play there are a ton of different weapons and 7 different classes at the moment. This game has done really well with the audio and visuals so it just looks and sounds like an aliens set. The story is short but fun to play through and there is a good amount of different enemy types in it that will keep you interested. The main thing where this game fails and fails pretty hard is multiplayer with randos mostly. About half your matches will be "lost connection to host" or something along those lines and you will lose a bunch of challenge cards to this as well as ya know your time. This game uses peer to peer from what i understand so if the hosts connection drops or yours does it kicks you back to the main ship and you get nothing for your progress except intel grabs. That is about the only problem this game really seems to have if that is fixed i definitely plan on grabbing the DLC as everything else is fun to mess around with.

Left 4 Dead + Gears of War

A welcome palette cleanser after Aliens Colonial Marines, Fireteam Elite is a three player co-op game based in the Aliens universe. The game also incorporates elements of Prometheus into the story and gameplay in a way that's better than anything Ridley Scott could have done. 

A fun, lovingly crafted game that isn't without a few flaws. The amount of lore and care that went into this game is a testament to the fact that it was crafted by fans of the franchise and not just cynical devs looking to make a buck. The campaign has you fighting mostly the iconic xenomorphs, but a few missions will see you up against Weyland-Yutani combat andriods and black goo mutants to change things up.

There's a bunch of weapons to unlock, and the fact that many of them can be bought means that the games progression is not as grindy as many of its contemporaries. Perhaps a little too easy on the standard difficulty, you might want to play this on something harder. The Challenge Card mechanic, which makes matches harder or easier depending on the effect, is an interesting addition that reminds me of the skulls in Halo. 

Once the campaign is completed the first time, you unlock several different game types including a horde mode that resembles Gears of War. However, these only feature the xenomorphs and I wish there were options to choose between the aliens, androids or the mutant creatures just for some variety. The robots and xenomorphs are fun to fight, but the mutants are a little stale. Effectively, they are just zombies, and the smaller ones resemble flood from Halo or headcrabs from Half Life. Kind of irritating, but they aren't in enough levels of the game for it to truly be a complaint. 85% of the time, you are fighting aliens. 

I would recommend this for Aliens fans or anyone passively familar with the franchise who's looking for a decent co-op game.
One of the video games of all time

You get to live the life of a space marine in the Alien universe.  
The game feels and sounds great and has an interesting story line.
The devs appear to be pushing out updates at a decent rate which is good.

The only downside is that it's very short and starts to become a boring loop after a while.   
Could use more story and maps.

If you're a fan of the Alien franchise like myself then you will enjoy it for sure.
